blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: To address unreliable cross-view association in long-sequence feed-forward dense SLAM, this letter presents V3DSAM, an open-vocabulary semantic dense SLAM system that establishes physical correspondences at both the scene and object levels. The system combines feed-forward geometric estimates from VGGT-SLAM 2.0 with open-vocabulary semantic observations from SAM3. We introduce semantic-geometric dual-scale loop verification, which identifies false loop closures using pixel-level bidirectional reprojection and object-level 3D spatial correspondences, without accessing backbone-internal features. We further propose geometry-anchored persistent instance mapping, which defines physical instances through class-constrained 3D connectivity in an optimized global coordinate system and assigns global IDs without inter-frame identity propagation. The proposed verifier rejects all four false loop candidates in our TUM RGB-D evaluation, while long-sequence ScanNet experiments show improved instance identity consistency. Thus, V3DSAM reduces dependence on internal backbone features and temporal ID propagation for robust long-term cross-view association.
blocks.zh: 为了解决长序回馈-向后稠密的 SLAM 中不可靠的交叉视图关联问题,本信介绍了 V3DSAM,一种开通-vobulary semic 稠密的 SLAM 系统,在现场和物体两级建立物理通信. 该系统结合了从VGGT-SLAM 2.0得到的向导几何估计,以及从SAM3得到的开放式语义观测. 我们引入了语义-几何双相阶回路校验,通过像素级双向再投影和对象级三维空间对接来识别假回路闭路,而不访问主干-内部特性. 我们进一步建议绘制几何 -- -- 受干扰的持久实例图,该图通过优化全球坐标系统中受类约束的三维连通来界定物理实例,并在不传播框架间身份的情况下指定全球标识。 提议的核查员拒绝我们TUM RGB-D评价中所有四个虚假的回路候选人,而长序ScanNet实验显示实例识别一致性得到提高。 因此,V3DSAM可以减少对内部骨干特征和时间标识传播的依赖,以建立强有力的长期交叉视图联系。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Visual simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) is fundamental to autonomous navigation, augmented reality, and 3D scene understanding. Recently, visual geometry foundation models such as VGGT have enabled feed-forward estimation of camera poses and dense scene geometry through large-scale multiview pretraining, providing a new geometric basis for dense visual SLAM [ 1 ] . Meanwhile, open-vocabulary vision models, including the SAM family and CLIP, enable flexible category- and object-level semantics in 3D scene representations, facilitating semantic SLAM systems that combine geometric reconstruction with open-vocabulary scene understanding [ 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 ] .
blocks.zh: 视觉同步本地化和绘图(SLAM)对于自主导航,增强现实,以及3D场景理解至关重要. 最近,VGGT等视觉几何基础模型通过大规模多景预训,对相机的姿势和密集场景几何进行了信息前向估计,为密集视觉SLAM[1]提供了新的几何基础. 同时,开放性vocabulary视觉模型,包括SAM家族和CLIP,可以在3D场景表现中实现灵活的类别和对象级语义,促进语义上的SAMM系统结合几何重建与开放性vocabulary场景理解[2,3,4,5].

blocks.en: Fig. 1: Dense RGB and semantic point clouds, camera trajectories, and instance-labeled observations from three viewpoints (C1–C3).
blocks.zh: 费格。 1: dense RGB和语义点云,相机轨迹,以及三个角度的实例标记观测(C1-C3).

blocks.en: A central challenge in extending local feed-forward geometry to long-sequence SLAM is establishing reliable and persistent physical correspondences across observations separated in time and viewpoint. The challenge manifests as scene-level false loop closures and object-level instance drift. At the scene level, appearance-based image retrieval can efficiently generate revisit candidates, but visual similarity does not guarantee that a physical location has been revisited; false-positive loop constraints may cause trajectory drift and map deformation. At the object level, association based on local temporal propagation or 2D appearance features may suffer from identity fragmentation and ID reassignment under long temporal gaps and large viewpoint changes.
blocks.zh: 将本地信息前导几何学扩展至长序SLAM的一个中心挑战是,在时间和观点上分开的观测中建立可靠和持续的物理通信。 挑战表现为场景层面的假环闭塞和对象层面实例漂移. 在场景层面,基于外观的图像检索可以高效地生成重访候选人,但视觉相似性并不能保证一个物理位置被重审;假阳性循环限制可能导致轨迹漂移和地图变形. 在物体一级,基于当地时间传播或2D外观特征的关联可能因长期时间差距和大视角变化而出现身份分裂和ID重置。

blocks.en: Fig. 1 visualizes the outputs of V3DSAM, our open-vocabulary semantic dense SLAM system. Its main contributions are:
blocks.zh: 图1可视化V3DSAM的输出,我们的开放-vobulary语义密集的SLAM系统. 其主要贡献是:

blocks.en: 1) Semantic-geometric dual-scale loop verification. Using only explicit feed-forward geometry and external open-vocabulary semantics, the method distinguishes true and false loops through bidirectional pixel-level reprojection and object-level 3D spatial correspondence. It does not rely on backbone-internal features and suppresses trajectory drift caused by false-positive loops.
blocks.zh: 1) 语义-几何双尺度循环验证. 该方法仅使用明显的feed-forward几何和外部的开元语义,通过双向像素级重排和对象级3D空间对应来区分真假循环. 它不依赖骨干内部特征,并抑制假阳性循环引起的轨迹漂移.

blocks.en: 2) Geometry-anchored persistent instance mapping. Multiview semantic observations are fused in a globally optimized world coordinate system. Voxelization and class-constrained 3D connectivity analysis form physical instances, and each valid connected component receives a globally unique instance ID. This avoids inter-frame temporal ID propagation and improves identity consistency across long-term revisits.
blocks.zh: 2)几何-焦虑的持久实例绘图. 多景语义观测被融合在一个全球优化的世界坐标系统中. Voxelization和类约束的3D连通性分析形成物理实例,每个有效的连接组件都得到全球独有实例ID. 这避免了跨框架时间标识的传播,并改进了长期重访中的身份一致性。

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Feed-Forward Visual Geometry and Dense SLAM
blocks.zh: II-A Feed-Forward 视觉几何和Dense SLAM

blocks.en: Traditional iterative visual SLAM systems, such as ORB-SLAM3 and DROID-SLAM, estimate camera poses and 3D structure by iterative bundle adjustment with hand-crafted features or dense photometric constraints [ 6 , 7 , 8 ] . Recently, visual geometry foundation models, including DUSt3R, MASt3R, and VGGT, have learned global geometric priors from large-scale multiview pretraining. Given one or more images, they directly predict camera poses, dense depth, and 3D point clouds without frame-by-frame iterative optimization [ 1 ] , [ 9 ] , [ 10 ] . Building on these models, MASt3R-SLAM, VGGT-SLAM, and VGGT-SLAM 2.0 combine keyframe management, local maps, loop closure, and global optimization to extend feed-forward geometry to long-sequence dense SLAM [ 11 ] , [ 12 ] , [ 13 ] . This work further investigates the consistency of cross-view association in long sequences.
blocks.zh: 传统的迭代视觉SLAM系统,如ORB-SLAM3和DROID-SLAM,通过带有手工设计的特性或密集的测光约束的迭代捆绑调整来估计相机的姿势和3D结构[6,7,8]. 最近,视觉几何基础模型,包括DUst3R,MAST3R,和VGGT,从大规模多视图预训中学习了全球几何前身. 考虑到一个或多个图像,它们直接预测相机的姿势,密集的深度,以及3D点云,而不逐帧的迭代优化[1],[9],[10]. 在这些模型的基础上,MAST3R-SLAM,VGGT-SLAM,和VGGT-SLAM 2.0结合了密钥帧管理,局部地图,环闭,以及全球优化,将向导几何学扩展到长序稠密的SLAM [11], [12], [13]. 这项工作进一步调查了交叉视图关联在长序中的一致性.

blocks.en: II-B Loop Candidate Retrieval and Verification
blocks.zh: 二-B 循环候选人检索和核实

blocks.en: Loop-closure processing comprises candidate retrieval (loop detection) and loop verification. The former retrieves potential revisit pairs from historical keyframes, whereas the latter rejects false candidates to prevent erroneous constraints from affecting global optimization.
blocks.zh: 环闭式处理包括候选检索(roop reference)和循环核查. 前者从历史键盘中取回可能的对子,而后者则拒绝假候选人,以防止错误的限制影响全球优化。

blocks.en: Candidate retrieval commonly uses global image descriptors such as NetVLAD and SALAD [ 14 ] , [ 15 ] ; Hydra instead employs hierarchical 3D scene structures for loop association [ 16 ] . Conventional verification often relies on geometric registration such as ICP, which performs reliably in scale-consistent iterative SLAM but may be challenged by noise in feed-forward geometry and semantic ambiguity [ 17 ] .
blocks.zh: 候选人检索通常使用全局图像描述符,如NetVLAD和SALAD[14],[15];Hydra转而使用等级3D的场景结构来进行循环关联[16]. 常规核查往往依靠几何登记,例如比较方案,这种登记在符合比例的迭代SLAM中运行可靠,但可能会受到向导几何和语义模糊的噪音的挑战[17]。

blocks.en: In feed-forward SLAM, MASt3R-SLAM reprocesses candidate frames through its backbone for two-view inference and verifies them using matching quality, coupling verification to the encoder and introducing additional inference cost [ 13 ] . EC3R-SLAM uses a homography-RANSAC inlier ratio for loop verification, relying on geometric cues without object-level semantics [ 18 ] . VGGT-SLAM 2.0 extracts the signal α m ​ a ​ t ​ c ​ h \alpha_{match} from VGGT attention layers to verify retrieved candidates without additional training; however, this signal is tied to a specific network architecture and is less readily reusable. Establishing interpretable cross-view physical correspondence from explicit feed-forward 3D geometry and independent semantic observations, without using backbone-specific features, therefore remains of interest.
blocks.zh: 在Feed-forward SLAM中,MAst3R-SLAM通过主干处理候选框架进行双视推论,并使用匹配的质量进行验证,将验证与编码器结合,并引入额外的推论成本[13]. EC3R-SLAM使用一个homography-RANSAC的nlier比进行循环验证,依靠没有对象级语义的几何提示[18]. VGGT-SLAM 2.0从 VGGT 注意层中提取信号 α m a t c h\alpha_{-match} 以验证被检索到的候选人而无需额外的训练;然而,这个信号与特定的网络架构捆绑在一起,更不易重复使用. 因此,在不使用骨干特定特征的情况下,通过明确的Feed-forward 3D几何学和独立语义观测建立可解释的交叉视图物理对应,仍然令人感兴趣。

blocks.en: II-C Cross-View Instance Association and Open-Vocabulary Instance Mapping
blocks.zh: II-C 跨实例协会和开放式词汇绘图

blocks.en: Early instance SLAM methods often depend on predefined semantic categories or local instance association. MaskFusion establishes instance correspondences using 2D masks and temporal tracking [ 19 ] , PanopticFusion fuses panoptic observations into a 3D voxel map to maintain identities [ 20 ] , and SGS-SLAM jointly optimizes geometry and semantics with 3D Gaussian representations [ 21 ] . Nevertheless, stable identities remain challenging across long temporal gaps and large viewpoint changes.
blocks.zh: 早期实例 SLAM方法往往依赖于预先定义的语义类别或本地实例关联. MaskFusion建立实例通信,使用2D口罩和时间跟踪[19],PanopticFusion将泛光学观测线制成3D voxel映射以保持身份[20],SGS-SLAM联合优化几何学和语义学,3D Gaussian代表[21]. 然而,在长期存在的差距和大的变化中,稳定的身份仍然具有挑战性。

blocks.en: With advances in vision-language pretraining, CLIP-Fields aggregates CLIP features into 3D point clouds for point-level open-vocabulary queries, primarily targeting offline multiview fusion [ 22 ] . OVO combines semantic categories, vision-language embeddings, temporal tracking, and spatial constraints to build instance-level maps, but long-term identity persistence remains limited [ 23 ] . These approaches place greater emphasis on semantic representation richness than on long-term identity consistency.
blocks.zh: 随着视觉语言预训的进步,CLIP-Fields将CLIP的特征集成到3D点云中,用于点级开放-vobulary查询,主要针对离线多视图聚变[22]. OVO结合语义分类,视觉语言嵌入,时间跟踪,空间约束来构建实例级地图,但长期身份持久性仍然有限[23]. 这些方法更多地强调语义代表性的丰富性,而不是长期身份一致性。

blocks.en: For semantic mapping built on feed-forward geometry, SceneVGGT back-projects SAM masks to construct semantic point clouds, but instance partitioning still depends heavily on inter-frame 2D semantic-label matching [ 24 ] . IRIS-SLAM fine-tunes the feed-forward backbone to learn dedicated instance embeddings, coupling its approach to internal model representations [ 25 ] . In multiview 3D instance construction, Open3DIS and MaskClustering use 2D masks to guide 3D instance aggregation, but do not specifically address noise in predicted feed-forward geometry [ 26 ] , [ 27 ] . Maintaining long-term global instance identities under such geometric noise, without temporal ID propagation, remains an open challenge.
blocks.zh: 对于基于feed-forward几何的语义绘图,SceneVGGT back-project SAM 口罩用于构建语义点云,但实例分区仍然严重依赖于2D语义标签间匹配[24]. IRIS-SLAM微调向导主干线,以学习专用实例嵌入,结合其对内部模型表示的方法[25]. 在多视图3D实例构建中,Open3DIS和MaskClustering使用2D口罩来引导3D实例聚合,但没有在预测的向导几何中具体处理噪声[26],[27]. 在这种几何噪声下保持长期的全球实例特征,而不传播临时身份证,仍然是一项公开的挑战。

blocks.en: III Method
blocks.zh: 三、结 论 方法

blocks.en: III-A Overview of V3DSAM
blocks.zh: 三、A. V3DSAM概览

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 2, V3DSAM takes a continuous monocular RGB sequence as input. VGGT-SLAM 2.0 and SAM3 provide camera intrinsics and extrinsics, dense depth, and semantic masks. An appearance-retrieval module generates loop candidates, which are processed by semantic-geometric dual-scale verification. Only candidates satisfying both consistency constraints enter global geometric optimization. In the resulting optimized world coordinate system, multiview semantic observations are fused by geometry-anchored instance assignment to construct a persistent dense 3D instance map.
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,V3DSAM采用连续单光学的RGB序列作为输入. VGGT-SLAM 2.0和SAM3提供相机内在和外观,密集深度,语义口罩. 外观检索模块生成循环考生,这些考生通过语义-几何双尺度验证处理. 只有满足两种一致性限制的候选人才能进入全球几何优化。 在由此形成的优化世界坐标系统中,多景语义观测通过几何-安居式实例分配来结合,构建一个持续密集的3D实例图.

blocks.en: C p ​ i ​ x C_{pix} measures local dense semantic alignment but can be disturbed by fragmented masks and partial occlusion. We therefore introduce an object-level constraint. Within each frame, 3D semantic points of the same class are spatially clustered; noisy clusters containing fewer than N min N_{\min} points are filtered out. Each valid cluster is represented by its 3D centroid. Object correspondence between frames is then established using the known relative pose 𝐓 c ← q \mathbf{T}_{c\leftarrow q} . A match must satisfy two conditions: the semantic classes agree, and the 3D Euclidean distance between centroids after pose transformation is below a preset threshold. Bidirectional matching is performed for q → c q\rightarrow c and c → q c\rightarrow q , and the number of matched objects in each direction is counted.

blocks.en: Conventional instance association frequently propagates instance IDs through matches between adjacent frames. This makes identity depend strongly on temporal order: long-term revisits or severe occlusions can break the tracking chain, causing ID changes and identity resets.

blocks.en: Physical instances are defined by paths in the adjacency graph: two voxels of the same class belong to the same instance if a path of neighboring same-class voxels connects them. This connectivity relation is an equivalence relation and partitions the voxel set into disjoint connected components, each representing a physical 3D instance. A KD-tree performs neighborhood searches among voxels of the same class, and a union-find algorithm efficiently computes the connected components. After discarding noisy components with fewer voxels than a minimum threshold, each remaining component receives a unique global instance ID that serves as the persistent identity of the physical entity.
blocks.zh: 物理实例由附图中的路径来定义:如果邻接同级的Voxel的路径连接它们,则同级的两个voxel属于同一实例. 这种连接关系是一种等效关系,将voxel设定为断连接组件,每个组件代表一个物理3D实例. KD- tree在同类的 voxels 中执行邻里搜索, 并且一个 Union- find 算法高效计算连接的组件 。 在丢弃声波小于最低阈值的噪音组件后,每个剩余组件都会得到独特的全球实例ID,作为物理实体的持续身份.

blocks.en: IV Experiments and Results
blocks.zh: 四. 实验和结果

blocks.en: IV-A Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: IV-A 实验设置

blocks.en: IV-A 1 Datasets
blocks.zh: IV-A 1 数据集

blocks.en: Experiments use ScanNet [ 28 ] and TUM RGB-D [ 29 ] indoor datasets. The TUM RGB-D experiments cover eight Freiburg1 sequences. With a unified front-end configuration, these sequences yield 15 SALAD loop candidates: 11 true and four false loops. Together with four ScanNet scenes, the evaluation contains 46 candidate frame pairs. All hyperparameters of the loop-verification module are selected using TUM RGB-D only and transferred directly to ScanNet without retuning, to test cross-dataset generalization under fixed parameters.
blocks.zh: 实验使用ScanNet[28]和TUM RGB-D[29]室内数据集. TUM RGB-D实验涵盖8个弗赖堡1序列. 有了统一的前端配置,这些序列产生15个SALAD循环候选:11个真和4个假循环. 与四个ScanNet场景一起,评价包含46个候选帧对. 循环校验模块的所有超参数都仅使用TUM RGB-D进行选择,并直接转移到ScanNet而不进行调试,在固定参数下测试跨数据集通用化.

blocks.en: IV-A 2 Parameters and Hardware
blocks.zh: IV-A 2 参数和硬件

blocks.en: VGGT-SLAM 2.0 provides the feed-forward geometry, and SAM3 generates open-vocabulary semantic observations for keyframes. On TUM RGB-D, each submap contains 32 frames and the SALAD candidate threshold is 0.95.
blocks.zh: VGGT - SLAM (英语). 2.0提供向导几何,SAM3为键框生成开放-vobulary语义观测. 在TUM RGB-D上,每个子图包含32帧,SALAD候选阈值为0.95.

blocks.en: For loop verification, the pixel- and object-level consistency thresholds are τ p ​ i ​ x = 0.10 \tau_{pix}=0.10 and τ o ​ b ​ j = 0.25 \tau_{obj}=0.25 , respectively. Within a frame, same-class 3D clustering uses a 0.3 m neighborhood threshold and removes sparse clusters containing fewer than 80 points. Persistent instance mapping uses a 0.02 m voxel resolution and a 0.05 m 3D neighborhood connection distance, and filters out connected components containing fewer than 100 voxels.
blocks.zh: 为进行循环校验,像素和对象级一致性阈值为\\ p i x = 0.10\ tau_{pix = 0.10 和 \ o b j = 0.25\ tau_{obj = 0.25 。 在帧内,同级的3D集群使用0.3米的邻里阈值,并清除含有不到80分的稀疏集群. 持久性实例映射使用0.02 m voxel分辨率和0.05 m 3D邻接连接距离,并过滤出含有不到100 voxels的连接组件.

blocks.en: Experiments are conducted on an NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU and an Intel i7-14700 CPU.
blocks.zh: 在NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU和Intel i7-14700 CPU上进行实验.

blocks.en: IV-A 3 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: IV-A 3 评价计量

blocks.en: Trajectory accuracy is measured using absolute trajectory error (ATE-RMSE). Loop verification is evaluated using a confusion matrix, precision, recall, and F1-score.
blocks.zh: 轨迹精度使用绝对轨迹误差(ATE-RMSE)测量. 循环核查使用混淆矩阵、精度、召回和F1-分数进行评估。

blocks.zh: 遵循[30]中基于重叠的循环标签原则,我们从利用地面真实度和深度计算共享3D可见度的程度来定义循环地面真相。

A candidate is labeled a true loop only if its temporal separation exceeds 20 frames and its overlap is at least 0.30. Ground truth is used for offline evaluation only, not during retrieval, verification, or optimization.

blocks.en: Instance mapping is also evaluated using standard instance-SLAM measures: multiple object tracking accuracy (MOTA), 4D panoptic quality (4D-PQ), and ID-switch count (IDS), for comparison with prior instance mapping methods [ 31 ] , [ 32 ] . These composite measures account for detection, segmentation, misses, false positives, and identity switches, but do not fully characterize identity persistence across long temporal intervals and loop revisits. We therefore additionally report identity-discrimination consistency (IDC), long-term reidentification recall (ReID-R), and instance coverage as targeted auxiliary metrics.

False loops often lack matchable 3D object structures that are visible in both views, resulting in low consistency scores at both the pixel and object levels. In contrast, true loops satisfy both pixel-level geometric alignment and object-level instance-matching constraints, yielding high scores on both measures.
blocks.zh: 图4显示了TUM RGB-D上由像素水平一致性C p i x C_{pix}和对象水平一致性C o b j C_{obj}定义的二维特征空间上的真与假循环候选人的明显区分. 假环往往缺乏可匹配的3D对象结构,在两种观点中都可见,导致像素和对象级别的一致性分数都很低. 相比之下,真环既满足了像素级几何对齐,又满足了对象级实例比对的制约,在两种度量中都得出了很高的分数.

blocks.en: We remove the false loops selected by the semantic-geometric dual-scale verification module before global pose optimization. Table II reports the trajectory accuracy after removing these erroneous constraints.
blocks.zh: 我们删除由语义-几何双尺度验证模块选择的假环,然后进行全局姿势优化. 表二报告了消除这些错误限制后的轨迹准确性。

blocks.en: TABLE II: ATE-RMSE on eight TUM RGB-D sequences
blocks.zh: 表二: 8个TUM RGB-D序列的ATE-RMSE

blocks.en: The baseline results in Table II are taken from the publicly available VGGT-SLAM 2.0 study [ 12 ] . The table compares absolute trajectory error (ATE-RMSE) across eight TUM RGB-D sequences for several recent SLAM systems. ”Ours (no Verification)” is an ablation that removes semantic-geometric dual-scale verification and directly accepts all candidate loops. Without verification, false loops introduce erroneous pose constraints and corrupt global trajectory optimization. As a result, severe drift and increased ATE occur on the perceptually ambiguous fr1/360 and fr1/room sequences. Enabling our verification method filters out these false candidates and prevents their constraints from degrading the back-end optimization. Overall, our method yields pose accuracy comparable to VGGT-SLAM 2.0’s internal attention score α m ​ a ​ t ​ c ​ h \alpha_{match} , while suppressing false-loop interference and preserving the global correction obtained from true loops.
blocks.zh: 表二中的基准结果取自公开的VGGT-SLAM 2.0研究[12]. 该表比较了8个TUM RGB-D序列对最近几个SLAM系统的绝对轨迹误差(ATE-RMSE). “我们的(不核查)”是一种取消语义-几何双尺度核查并直接接受所有候选循环的废品。 没有核查,虚假的循环就会产生错误的限制和腐败的全球轨道优化。 因此,在感知不清的fr1/360和fr1/room序列上出现了严重的漂移和增加的ATE. 使我们的核查方法能够筛选出这些虚假候选人,防止其限制降低后端优化。 总体来说,我们的方法产量与VGGT-SLAM 2.0的内部关注得分(α m a t c h\alpha_{match ) 相当,同时抑制了假故障干扰并保留了从真实循环中获得的全球校正。

blocks.en: Fig. 5: Trajectories before and after loop verification: (a) fr1/room; (b) ScanNet scene0207_00. Gray: ground truth; red: optimized trajectory without removing false loops; blue: trajectory with the proposed loop verification.
blocks.zh: 图5:循环核查前后的轨迹:(a)fr1/房间;(b)ScanNet scene0207_00。 灰色:地面真理;红色:优化轨迹而不去除虚假环路;蓝色:轨迹与提议的环路验证.

blocks.en: TABLE III: Loop verification and trajectory results on long ScanNet sequences
blocks.zh: 表三:长扫描网序列的循环核查和轨迹结果

blocks.en: As shown in Table III, when all candidates are true, the verification module retains all valid geometric constraints and the trajectory accuracy is unchanged. Only when false loops are detected does the module remove erroneous constraints and correct the back-end optimization. On scene0207_00, the method identifies and removes two false loops, reducing ATE from 0.109 m to 0.089 m. For the other scenes, which have no false candidates, the method retains valid loop constraints without reducing pose accuracy.
blocks.zh: 如表三所示,当所有考生都属实时,核查模块保留所有有效的几何限制,轨迹精度不变. 只有当检测到虚假循环时,模块才会消除错误的制约,纠正后端优化. 在Scene0207_00上,该方法识别并移除了两个假环,ATE从0.109米减少到0.089米. 对于其他没有假候选人的场景,该方法保留了有效的循环限制而不降低姿势准确性.

blocks.en: The trajectory correction achieved by loop verification is shown in Fig. 5. False constraints introduce mutually incompatible geometric relations in the pose graph and pull estimated poses away from ground truth. Together with the ATE values in Tables II and III, the trajectory plots show that filtering false-positive loops removes conflicting constraints and improves agreement with ground truth.
blocks.zh: 通过循环验证实现的轨迹校正以图表示. 5. 假约束在姿势图中引入了相互不相容的几何关系,并拉动了估计与地面真相的距离。 轨迹图与表二和表三中的ATE值一起显示,过滤假阳性环路可以消除相互冲突的制约,改善与地面真理的一致。

blocks.en: IV-C Geometry-Anchored Persistent Instance Mapping
blocks.zh: IV-C 几何学 -- -- 编年史绘图

blocks.en: Fig. 6: Cross-view visualization of persistent instance identities on long ScanNet sequences. The first three columns show consecutive keyframes and the last two show revisit frames. Different colors denote different global instance IDs. From top to bottom: SAM3 Tracking, CLIP Association, OVO, and V3DSAM.
blocks.zh: 费格。 6:在长的ScanNet序列上对持久性实例身份进行交叉视觉可视化. 前三列显示连续键框,后两列显示复议框. 不同的颜色表示不同的全球实例ID. 从上到下:SAM3跟踪,CLIP协会,OVO,和V3DSAM.

blocks.en: TABLE IV: Persistent instance identity comparison on long ScanNet sequences
blocks.zh: 表格 四:长扫描网序列的持久实例标识比较

blocks.en: Table IV compares instance identity consistency on ScanNet with SAM3, CLIP, and OVO baselines [ 4 ] , [ 22 ] , [ 23 ] . OVO is evaluated using both ground-truth poses and depth (GTp+GTd) and poses and depth predicted by the VGGT front end (Vp+Vd).
blocks.zh: 表四将ScanNet上的实例标识一致性与SAM3、CLIP和OVO基线[4]、[22]、[23]进行比较。 OVO通过地面真实的姿势和深度(GTp+GTd)以及VGGT前端(Vp+Vd)预测的姿势和深度来评价.

blocks.en: Among the external baselines, SAM3 Tracking, which relies entirely on temporal mask propagation, has low long-term reidentification performance under our test configuration. Its ReID-R of zero indicates that none of the evaluated instances retained a matching identity across the designated revisits. CLIP Association, which relies on 2D appearance features, also shows weak revisit identity scores and a large number of ID switches. These results illustrate the difficulty of maintaining global identity under viewpoint and occlusion changes using only temporal 2D tracking or appearance.
blocks.zh: 在外部基线中,SAM3跟踪完全依靠时间遮罩传播,在我们的测试配置下,其长期重新识别性能较低. 它的ReID-R为0表示,所有被评价的事例都没有在指定的重新审视中保留匹配的身份. CLIP Association依靠2D外观特征,也显示重温身份分数较弱,并有大量ID开关. 这些结果表明,在只使用时间2D跟踪或外观的视角和隔离变化下维持全球身份存在困难。

blocks.en: Two conclusions follow from comparing V3DSAM under different geometric inputs. First, feed-forward geometry quality substantially affects instance identity consistency. Replacing the predicted geometry with ground truth markedly improves the targeted identity metrics, indicating that geometric noise is a major bottleneck for persistent instance mapping. Second, when both methods use the same ground-truth geometry, V3DSAM outperforms OVO (GTp+GTd) on IDC and ReID-R, as well as MOTA and 4D-PQ. This ablation shows that OVO benefits substantially from ground-truth input geometry, while, after controlling for input quality, our geometry-anchored partitioning method exhibits stronger cross-view instance association.
blocks.zh: 在不同的几何输入下比较V3DSAM得出两个结论. 首先,向导几何质量对实例识别一致性有重大影响。 用地面真理取代预测的几何,明显改进了有针对性的身份测量标准,表明几何噪声是持续实例绘图的一个主要瓶颈。 第二,当两种方法使用相同的地真几何时,V3DSAM在IDC和ReID-R以及MOTA和4D-PQ上的OVO(GTp+GTd)表现优于OVO. 这种偏差表明,OVO在很大程度上受益于地面-真实输入几何学,而在控制输入质量之后,我们的几何-焦虑的分隔方法显示出更强的交叉视图实例关联。

blocks.en: With ground-truth geometry, V3DSAM’s IDC and ReID-R increase substantially, whereas MOTA and 4D-PQ decrease. This indicates a complex relationship among geometric input quality, instance partitioning and matching, and composite metrics. More complete depth observations may introduce additional predicted regions, affecting false-positive and segmentation matching statistics. Multiple metrics must therefore be considered together when evaluating instance identity quality.
blocks.zh: 由于地面真实几何,V3DSAM的IDC和ReID-R大幅增加,而MOTA和4D-PQ则减少。 这表明几何输入质量、实例分割和匹配以及复合计量之间的复杂关系。 更完整的深度观测可能会引入更多的预测区域,影响假阳性和分化性匹配统计数据. 因此,在评价实例特征质量时,必须综合考虑多种衡量标准。

blocks.en: To isolate the effect of the class constraint, we remove the requirement of semantic-class agreement from the 3D adjacency graph while retaining all other mapping parameters. Across four ScanNet scenes, removing the class constraint reduces IDC from 0.565 to 0.220, instance coverage from 0.736 to 0.236, and 4D-PQ from 0.110 to 0.018. Geometric connected components alone can incorrectly merge nearby objects of different categories, causing severe under-segmentation. These results demonstrate that the class constraint is important for preserving the discriminability of global instances.
blocks.zh: 为了隔离类约束的影响,我们从3D辅助图中删除了语义类协议的要求,同时保留所有其他的映射参数. 在ScanNet的4个场景中,取消类限制将IDC从0.565减少到0.220,例覆盖从0.736减少到0.236,4D-PQ从0.110减少到0.018. 仅几何连接的组件就可能错误地将不同类别的邻近对象合并,导致严重的分层不足. 这些结果表明,阶级制约对于维护全球案例的歧视性十分重要。

blocks.en: Fig. 6 compares persistent instance identities across consecutive keyframes and long-term revisits on ScanNet. V3DSAM retains the same physical entities’ identity labels more consistently across revisits, while the three baselines exhibit varying degrees of ID switches, incorrect matching, or excessive instance fragmentation. Together with Table IV, the results indicate that OVO obtains relatively high instance coverage but weaker long-term identity metrics; higher detection coverage does not necessarily imply more consistent cross-view instance identity.
blocks.zh: 图6比较了ScanNet上连续的关键框架和长期重访的持久性实例。 V3DSAM在重新审视时更一致地保留同样的实体的身份标签,而三个基线显示不同程度的ID开关、不正确的匹配或过多的实例分裂。 与表四一起,结果显示OVO获得相对较高的实例覆盖面,但长期身份衡量标准较弱;更高的检测覆盖面并不一定意味着更一致的交叉视图实例标识.

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en: This paper presents V3DSAM, an open-vocabulary semantic mapping system for feed-forward dense SLAM with two complementary association mechanisms: semantic-geometric dual-scale loop verification and geometry-anchored persistent instance mapping. The first mechanism identifies false-positive loops using only explicit geometry and semantic outputs, without depending on backbone-internal features. The second assigns global instance IDs to class-constrained 3D connected components and avoids inter-frame temporal ID propagation. Experiments on TUM RGB-D and ScanNet demonstrate that V3DSAM suppresses trajectory drift from false loops, achieves localization accuracy comparable to native VGGT verification, and improves long-term instance identity consistency relative to the evaluated baselines.
blocks.zh: 本文介绍V3DSAM,是一种用于向导稠密的SLAM的开放-vobulary语义映射系统,具有两个互补的关联机制:语义-几何双尺度环形验证和几何-无常实例映射. 第一个机制只使用明显的几何和语义输出来识别假阳性循环,而不取决于骨干-内部特征. 第二种方式将全局实例ID指定为类约束的3D连接组件,并避免框架间时间ID传播. 在TUM RGB-D和ScanNet上的实验表明,V3DSAM抑制了假环的轨迹漂移,实现了与原生VGGT验证相仿的本地化精度,并且相对于被评价的基线提高了长期实例识别一致性.
